stations.name: Recover control
stations.get: Order in the project: branches, records and checks.

stations.name: Prove the bottlenecks
stations.get: One finished room, one complete Tom who walks, sits and turns, speech under 2 seconds, frame headroom.
stations.note: Open, not closed: it failed its first exit check on 22 October. Fresh reviewers re-run that check once the walk, the clothes and speech pass; phase 2 waits for it.

stations.name: Quay Street
stations.get: The whole street, day and night, built from proved pieces, with people in plain clothes.
stations.note: Waits until phase 1 passes. The shops already in the street stay.

stations.name: Thirty minutes that hold
stations.get: The town remembers what you did: arrivals, deliveries, consequences, the office and the ledger, talk.

stations.name: Friends' evening
stations.get: Your friends play thirty minutes on your PC, with a $5 cap per evening.
stations.note: Around January if phase 1 passes soon. Low confidence.

stations.name: The Hook
stations.get: The district: one more block, then the 14 main characters, about 30 regulars and a crowd.

stations.name: Crime and combat
stations.get: The escalation ladder: fists, improvised and carried weapons; guns rare, and last.

stations.name: Empire
stations.get: Your first business, first recruit and first racket, and a rival who reacts.

stations.name: The docks
stations.get: The docks beside the Hook, and background traffic once convincing fictional 1990 cars pass.

stations.name: The story: 15 to 20 hours, one main story, two or three endings
stations.get: Jobs, the main story and its endings.

stations.name: Release, late 2027
stations.get: Menus, music, polish and testing: one full release, not early access.

stations.name: After release: more districts, driving yourself
stations.get: Updates after release: Meridian's other districts, and driving yourself.

bosses.name: The Glide
bosses.what: How far a planted foot slides while Tom walks, stops and turns.
bosses.last: 27 Oct: found that Epic's walk and Tom's MetaHuman had never reached the packaged game (their files never went to the build machine); fixed, and the AI tester walked the whole route in it, 15 of 15. The first stop still drags 10 to 13 cm inside Epic's own clip; your eye passed it.

bosses.name: The Long Pause
bosses.what: Seconds from the end of your question to the character's first sound.
bosses.last: 3 Nov: run E inside the packaged game asked real questions after the deed: what goes to the better model took a median 2.33 s, 4 of 10 under 2.0 s; small talk 1.02 s, 18 of 20; no fall-backs. It rested on two questions asked five times each, so it cannot settle the bar: run F, twenty different newcomer questions, on the 3 to 4 November build.

bosses.name: The Stutter
bosses.what: The worst single frame on a walk down the street.
bosses.last: 3 Nov: three more packaged captures with the cast's voices: no frame over 33 ms, the worst 22 to 30 ms; absent in seven captures since 2 November. If the 3 to 4 November walk finds none either, it closes as not reproduced.

bosses.name: The Tailor
bosses.what: Period clothes on the cast, counted by pieces, starting with Tom's four. A piece is beaten when it passes in the packaged game with no open fault.
bosses.last: 2 Nov: the collar set aside after three tries (a fourth asked on your page); the pale line under the boots gone in four reviewed views with the ground's own fix, its halo tightened; Epic's boots in for the toe. No piece beaten yet.

pieces.name: Jacket
pieces.line: In the packaged game; one open fault: a patch of his throat shows at the zip (two tries used; a third waits on your yes).

pieces.name: Jumper
pieces.line: Made, and held back: under the zipped jacket it is never seen, and its neckband showed outside the collar.

pieces.name: Jeans
pieces.line: The straight 16.5 in cut, faded, worn over his boots in tonight's build; a fresh reviewer passed them in the editor; packaged walk tomorrow.

pieces.name: Boots
pieces.line: Ron's black lace-up boots on Tom, with leather maps; passed in the editor; open faults: a heavy, almost clog-like toe, and a pale band under the toes on wet paving (two tries each).

bosses.name: The Empty Chair
bosses.what: Someone sits down in the game as you play it.
bosses.display: Sits and stands in the packaged game; new faults found and being fixed
bosses.last: 3 Nov: walked in the packaged game with the 2 November fixes in: his face at most 25 degrees down, nobody touching, Ron waiting at the door end; a fresh reviewer of the packaged pictures next.

bosses.name: The Clean Room
bosses.what: Mickey's office worn, lived in and free of glitches, at the Hook sheet's bar.
bosses.display: Wear passed in the editor; packaged faults open
bosses.last: 3 Nov: packaged pictures by day and night, two fresh reviewers: the room holds; five small faults then fixed in the editor (the taken-down notices' edges and tape, the damp patch clear of the corner, a written message pad, the cars board naming places, a wall clock the game turns to its own time); packaged pictures again on the 3 to 4 November build.

bosses.name: The Memory Hog
bosses.display: Game alone 5.9 GB, under the 6 GB line
bosses.last: Down from 9.9 GB with the voice. Your ruling of 24 Oct: the 6 GB line counts the game alone; game and voice peak at 8.7 GB on your 10 GB card.

bosses.name: The Shadow Tax
bosses.what: Spare graphics card time, kept for what the street still needs.
bosses.last: Night beats its 1.4 ms target. Day is under its 2.5 ms target, accepted by your ruling of 24 Oct until phase 2's street budget.
